similar_in_english: Let the cat out of the bag
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার গোপন পরিকল্পনা হাটে হাঁড়ি ভাঙার মতো সবার সামনে প্রকাশ হয়ে গেল।
বেশি কথা বললে হাটে হাঁড়ি ভাঙবে, সাবধান।
example_sentences_in_english: His secret plan was revealed to everyone like breaking a pot in the market.
If you talk too much, you'll let the secret out—watch out.
history: This idiom originates from rural Bengali market culture, where breaking a pot in a crowded 'hat' (market) would attract public attention and embarrassment, symbolizing the irreversible public exposure of hidden matters.
note: Often used in contexts of caution against indiscreet speech.
